title: The Characteristic smell of the place
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：characteristic　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 characteristic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the foreman wrote of ① a characteristic smell of the place in the sheet, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② more characteristic than the one named there the year before. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the foreman, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the characteristic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most characteristic smell of the place anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the sheet for May 1955 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too characteristic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the characteristic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a characteristic gesture of hers, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as characteristic as the gesture of hers they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was characteristic or not, and he said so.

By 1968 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the sheet. What the line asked for was ⑦ something characteristic, and nothing besides. The worker from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite characteristic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the sheet kept the names of the characteristic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1971, before dawn, she wrote of another characteristic smell of the place in the same sheet, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ more characteristic than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most characteristic gesture of hers in the whole site, she said in 1973, was the one she could never quite name; the characteristic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 特有（前置定语 a characteristic smell of the place：1961 年工头在施工单里记下的那件特有的气味）
B. adj. 特有／典型（比较级 more characteristic than：文中两处，一处比那地方的气味，一处比预想）
C. adj. 特有／典型（最高级 the most characteristic：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 特有（表语 too characteristic to do：母亲觉得它太特有，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 典型（前置定语 a characteristic gesture of hers：叔叔把整件事称作一桩典型的手势）
F. adj. 典型（同级比较 as characteristic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩她的手势相比）
G. adj. 典型（后置定语 something characteristic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 典型（受程度副词修饰 quite characteristic：那位工人的评价）

items.q: a characteristic smell of the place
the most characteristic smell of the place anybody
The most characteristic gesture of hers in

answers.why: characteristic 意为“特有”，1961 年工头在施工单里记下的是“一件特有的气味”，此处作前置定语 a characteristic smell of the place。
characteristic 意为“特有”，此处用比较级 more characteristic than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
characteristic 意为“特有”，施工单上 五月 那行字说它是工地里最特有的一件，故用最高级 the most characteristic smell of the place。
characteristic 意为“特有”，母亲认为这件东西“太特有了，谁也用不上”，too characteristic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
characteristic 意为“典型”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩典型的手势”，此处作前置定语 a characteristic gesture of hers。
characteristic 意为“典型”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩她的手势一样典型”，同级比较用 as characteristic as。
characteristic 意为“典型”，施工单上那半行字要的是“典型的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something characteristic。
characteristic 意为“典型”，邻工地来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当典型”，quite 修饰原级 characteristic。
characteristic 意为“典型”，1971 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要典型”，故用比较级 more characteristic than。
characteristic 意为“典型”，母亲 1973 年说的是“整个工地里最典型的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most characteristic gesture of hers。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1961 年，工头在施工单里记下了一件特有的气味。（a characteristic smell of the place）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更特有。（more characteristic than …）
母亲觉得它太特有，谁也用不上。（too characteristic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩典型的手势。（a characteristic gesture of hers）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩她的手势一样典型。（as characteristic as …）
到了 1968 年，施工单上只剩半行字：要的是一件典型的东西。（something characteristic）
answers: In 1961 the foreman wrote of a characteristic smell of the place in the sheet.
Everybody said it was more characteristic than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too characteristic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a characteristic gesture of hers.
He said nobody would call it as characteristic as the gesture of hers they had once had.
By 1968 the sheet asked for nothing but something characteristic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 characteristic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1961 the foreman wrote of a characteristic smell of the place in the sheet, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most characteristic smell of the place in the site, or so the sheet says.
My mother thought it too characteristic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a characteristic gesture of hers, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next site called the plan quite characteristic, and everybody laughed.
The characteristic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
